notes.title: Ver.1.3.16 Update
notes.content:
Fixed the texture of the Showabashi tram stop sign.
 Fixed the road 3d model near the Jujigai.
 Fixed an issue where the rear door of the type 3000 did not animate.
 Fixed the animation of the pressure gauge needle on the type 3000.
 Enabled closing the pause menu with the ESC key (ESC key to resume operation).

notes.title: Ver.1.3.14 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting so long for our update!

 Added Type 3000 as a drivable tram

 Added Showabashi - Chiyogadai (2 sections)

 Improved automatic announcement sound quality

 Moved the stop line at Hakodate-Ekimae (for Yunokawa) closer

 Added side mirror UI (Can be toggled OFF/ON by pressing the M key)

 Repaired 3D models of deteriorated asphalt tracks

 Added standing room inside the tram (passenger capacity increased)

 The number of passengers now affects the acceleration/deceleration performance of the tram (beta)

 Fixed a bug where passengers overflowed at stops

Pedestrians now randomly press the button for push-button traffic lights



 The following items are planned to be addressed in the near future:

Setting to allow master controller return notch

Resolution of minor freezes (jumps) when entering Jujigai from Horaicho

Same update for MacOS version

notes.title: Ver.1.2.11 Update
notes.content:
Added support for macOS (Intel 64-bit / Apple Silicon)
 Fixed an issue where right-turning cars would stop moving at Jujigai and Chitose-cho
 Fixed a driving operation issue with the Zuiki One Handle Mascon.
 Fixed an issue where the driving condition UI appeared before selecting a scenario on the scenario selection screen


Note:
On macOS, rendering issues with the sky may occur when using full-screen mode. This will be fixed in a future update.

notes.title: Ver.1.2.9 mini update
notes.content:
Corrected an error in external announcements at Uoichibadori in the Yachigashira–Showabashi scenario.
 Fixed an issue where the announcement system's starting position was incorrectly set to Showabashi in the  Hakodate Ekimae–Hakodate Dock-mae scenario.
 Resolved the issue of overcrowding passengers at Horai-cho and Aoyagi-cho stops.
 Fixed a bug related to the fast-forward feature.

notes.title: Ver.1.2.7 Yachigashira Update
notes.content:
Added the section between Jujigai and Yachigashira.
 Fixed a bug causing trams to forcibly stop when doors are opened.
 Fixed an issue causing camera glitches when opening doors in external view.
 Added new automobile color variations.
 Updated the 3D models of tracks.
 Implemented random weather conditions: clear, cloudy, and foggy.
 Added 3D models around Hakodate Station.
 Temporarily removed the timetable from the driver's cab.



Known Issues & Planned Improvements:


 Settings are cleared after updates. (Future versions will save settings to Steam.)
 Resolving operational issues with SteamInput/ZUIKI Master Controller.
 Enhancing the audio quality of automated announcements.
 Fixing shadow rendering noise inside trams.
 Updating the initial 3D building models between Hakodate Dock-mae and Jujigai due to visual discrepancies caused by weather effects.
 Restoring the timetable to the driver's cab.
 Supporting macOS.

notes.title: TRAMCITY Price Update – Non-JPY Currencies
notes.content: Due to exchange rate changes, non-JPY pricing will be revised from April 2025.

notes.title: November 10, 2024 (v.1.1.17) Update
notes.content:
Updated the keyboard input system. (Key assignments remain unchanged)
 Fixed behavior when using gamepad and single-handle master controller.

notes.title: Oct. 1, 2024 (v.1.1.14) Update
notes.content: The automated announcement at Jujigai has been corrected.

notes.title: Sep 25, 2024 (v.1.1.13) Update
notes.content:
Extended the driving section to Showabashi. Right-turning cars now appear, but there is a bug in the algorithm, causing unstable behavior. Other changes are as follows:

 The driving section has been extended to Showabashi.
 The driver's name is now displayed.
 The car control program has been updated, and right-turning cars now appear. *Currently under debugging, and operation is unstable.
 Convenience feature: Added an automatic fare collection feature.
 Convenience feature: Added automatic camera angle change when the doors are open.
 Convenience feature: Time will automatically fast-forward while waiting at a red signal. *Currently under debugging, and operation is unstable.
 Adjusted the acceleration and deceleration performance of the 8000 series.
 Added new automated announcements from 2023 (Automated announcements by Hibiki Joe).
 Electric command braking system can now be selected (Revival of the feature from the trial version).
 A controller for train driving games can now be connected.

notes.title: June 10, 2024 (v.1.0.240610.1) Update
notes.content:
Added voices for 3 drivers
 Changed the display names of the drivers from real names to simple alphabets (A, B, C...)
 Modified some slope 3D models to have a gentler shape
 Added pedestrian routes
 Improved the acceleration performance of the type-8000
 Slightly increased the pressure at which the brakes of the type-8000 squeal

notes.title: April, 26th (v.1.0.240425.1) Update
notes.content:
Addition of Mr. Nozuki's voice to the tram driver announcements
 Modification of the entrance door buzzer activation conditions
 Correction of the female passenger walking animation
 Addition of a walking path for passengers from the sidewalk to the stop
 Fix for the issue where car indicators remain on between Jujigai and Hakodate Dock Mae
 Fix for the issue of cars ignoring traffic signals at Jujigai
 Adjustment of the red signal color at Jujigai
 Correction of the track geometry from Jujigai to Hakodate Eki Mae
 Fix for the issue where the "Step" indicator in the driver's panel does not light up

notes.title: Update on March 8, 2024 (v.1.0.240308.1)
notes.content:
Adjusted the braking performance.
 Fixed a bug where cars ignore signals.
 Reduced the drawing load of tracks and roads.
 Added 2nd stop line at the trolley control position of Jujigai.

notes.title: Update on February 4, 2024 (v.1.0.240204.1)
notes.content:
Added HUD display settings.
 Pressing the U key on the driving screen now toggles the HUD OFF/ON.
 Added Acceleration gauge display to the driving screen (the gauge color is yellow for strong braking, red for sudden braking. It is desirable for the gauge color to be white just before stopping. This will be included in the evaluation in future versions).
 Adjusted the acceleration/deceleration performance of the 8000 series.
 Reduced the running resistance of the 8000 series.
 Increased the rate of car generation.
 Adjusted the timing of the turnout sound after leaving Jujigai and the timing of the speed limit change in the Jujigai -> Suehiro-cho section

notes.title: January 21st 2024 (v.1.0.240121.1) Update
notes.content:
Added music volume setting
 Added new types of passenger 3D models

notes.title: January 12th 2024 (v.1.0.240112.1) Update
notes.content:
Added slide for operation guide
 Enhanced the brake release button's function for faster reduction of BC pressure when held down (simulating the position of the brake handle at the far left)

notes.title: 7th January 2024 Update
notes.content:
Removed unnecessary 3D models near the Suehiro-cho
 Modified some conditions for playing the driver's voice
 Adjusted the volume of the horn
 Adjusted the volume of announcements
 Enabled pressing the disembarking (fare collection) button with the space key
 Reduced the running resistance of the tram
 Shortened the delay of the tram's brakes
 Adjusted the acceleration performance of the tram
